# Warranty

## What is covered

| Part | Coverage |
|---|---|
| Frame and fork | Lifetime, for the original owner |
| E-bike motor | 2 years |
| E-bike battery | 3 years or 800 full charge cycles, whichever comes first |
| Drivetrain, brakes, wheels | 1 year |
| Paint and finish | 6 months |

Wear parts (tyres, brake pads, chains, cassettes, grips) are never covered.

## Making a claim

A claim needs the bike's serial number, which is stamped under the bottom
bracket and starts with `NWB`. Ask the customer for a photo of the serial
number and a photo or video of the fault. Claims are filed in the warranty
portal and are answered within 3 business days.

## Battery claims

A battery is replaced under warranty when its capacity has dropped below 70%
of new within the coverage period. The capacity is read by a Northwind service
partner with the diagnostic app, never estimated from the customer's range.
